verdict.rationale: Storage billing is a fair question for a serverless platform that binds to storage products like KV, D1, R2 and Durable Objects, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never says how storage is billed or whether it grows automatically. The only usage-based pricing claims cover compute time (not wall time), idle agents costing nothing, and Workers AI avoiding payment for unused infrastructure; none of these addresses storage bytes or capacity.
